observations.existing_producers: All three packages link to the existing once-only quest completion actions and their xp_reward effects.
observations.client_of_kourend: Client of Kourend awards two independent 500-XP antique lamps in any skill. The existing catalog has a single completion producer with quantity 2 and two separately spendable instances.
observations.dream_mentor: Dream Mentor completion grants one 15,000-XP dreamy lamp for Strength, Defence, Hitpoints, Ranged or Magic. Both registry rows describe the same award. The main account profile allows any skill under its existing quest-lamp setting.
observations.great_brain_robbery: The Great Brain Robbery completion grants a retainable blessed lamp worth 5,000 XP in a chosen skill at draft minimum base level 30. Independent live verification of the 'above level 30' wording remains outstanding.
observations.ledger: Three registry entries move from expected to collected draft with their existing completion action links and modeled package fields.
